messages:
Asha: Quick thought 8: Sunset boardgames + sangria on the roof? Wed 6:30-9. Casual, bring a game or drink to share. Thoughts?
Ben: Love it. Ill bring Codenames and a portable table.
Clara: In! Can someone do a non-alc sangria option? Im driving. :wave:
Devon: I can make a big pitcher of non-alc sangria (berries + sparkling water). Also will bring collapsible cups.
Emma: RSVP format suggestion: `Yes / Maybe / No + headcount + game/drink contrib`  makes tallying easier.
Asha: Perfect format. I'll post a tiny poll tomorrow AM for rooftop vs lounge (weather fallback).
Ben: Also quick ask  can we do a soft noise curfew at 8:45? Some neighbors are sensitive.
Clara: Agree. 8:45 gentle wind-down works.
Devon: I'll bring a small battery speaker + playlist. Low volume after 8:30.
Emma: Can someone bring a deck of cards? If trivia empties we can do quick rounds.
Ben: Cards + Codenames covered. Also I'll bring a set of score pads and pens.
Asha: Logistics: volunteers for setup/cleanup? 15m each.
Clara: I can do cleanup shift 1 (after 8:45).
Devon: Setup for me. I'll arrive 6:00 to stack tables.
calendar-bot: Event created  "Sunset Boardgames & Sangria"  Wed 2025-11-05 18:30  Location: Rooftop (alt: Lounge). RSVP in thread.
Asha: Facilities note: @facilities any restrictions for roof glassware or open flames?
facilities: Please use unbreakable cups on rooftop. No open flames. Keep glass to the Lounge only. Also please return tables to original positions.
Emma: Noted. I'll bring unbreakable mason-style cups and labels for drinks (avoid mixups).
Ben: Food? Small snack share ok? I can do popcorn + mixed nuts (labelled).
Clara: Ill bring fruit skewers (GF).
Devon: Non-alc pitcher + stirrers on me.
Asha: Cool. I'll run the poll tomorrow 9am and post a quick checklist. See y'all then! :sunset:
